sentences.en: We're playing tag. Do you want to play with us?

sentences.en: Can you please help me put price tags on everything?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我给所有东西贴上价格标签吗？

sentences.en: Don't forget to add the tag "@change" to incorrect sentences.
sentences.zh: 别忘了在错误的句子后面加上@change标签。
